Team —

Thanks again for interviewing Jamie (Senior Infra). Two quick asks so we can close this loop today:

1) Please drop your final numerical score + 1–2 line rationale in the attached scorecard template by 3pm PT today. I attached the template; if you already have scores in GH or elsewhere, a PDF or short reply is fine.

2) We need one short tie-break window to do a final 20-min follow-up (technical clarifications) if anyone has a blocking question. Proposed windows (PT): 11:30–12:00, 13:00–13:30, 16:00–16:30. Please reply with your availability (rank order) so I can strawpoll and lock a time.

Context: feedback so far is mixed on system design depth vs production readiness; we want to avoid a long re-interview and just run a quick clarifying chat if needed. If majority votes to move to offer, we’ll skip the follow-up.

Attaching: scorecard-template.pdf for quick capture.

Thanks —
